notes.title: Discovery Yard Investigation - Update 10/04/2020
notes.notes:
Hello Detectives!

We are working to make the game always better!

This update resolved some bugs reported by players.


Changelog:

MotionBlur: It is temporarily disabled (soon we will put the option to activate and deactivate).

ButtonRead: We removed this option to avoid the "FullHealth" bug. There is now an exclusive document talking about the weapons of crime.

English version: Document on weapons of crime has been translated correctly.



Soon we will be providing a more detailed manual regarding all commands and with tips on how to solve the mysteries.

In the discussion forum we will create a topic explaining how you can better report any errors you find. Some players talk about passwords that do not work and it is very difficult for us to know what mystery it is about since 4 random mysteries are drawn.

We ask for patience. We are just a team of 1 person rsss and we are working on a second project that soon we will talk more about it for you.

Thank you all!
BRUNOARTS Entertainment
